title: OpenRouter DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 blinded evidence-variant continuation
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 reasoning and broker-mediated response requests across incidents02-12 and four instruction profiles relative to contemporaneous controls?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Continuation of EXP-OPENROUTER-DEEPSEEK-V4-FLASH-0731-INCIDENT01-VARIANTS-001. Covers incidents02-12 with the identical frozen Relace-pinned transport, four profiles, and BASE plus three opaque evidence variants. Provider fallback is disabled. The provider-facing final-report schema omits uniqueItems while the unchanged local assessment validator enforces the complete schema. Response actions remain exclusively broker-mediated. Evaluator-only mappings are excluded and every attempt is retained.
